certificates.title: Certificates
certificates.empty.heading: No certificates yet
certificates.empty.body: Resale certificates and tax documents your buyers upload appear here, with their expiry dates.
certificates.noResults.heading: No certificates match these filters
certificates.gated.body: Track expiry dates, send automatic renewal requests and review certificates. Your buyers' existing certificates stay listed here.
certificates.rules.auto: Certificates are marked Expiring soon {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} before expiry. Buyers get a renewal request 30 and 7 days before.
certificates.rules.manual: Certificates are marked Expiring soon {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} before expiry. Automatic renewal requests are off.
certificates.flag.pastExpiry: Already past this date when uploaded
certificates.decision.heading: This certificate has expired
certificates.decision.body: The buyer still has the tax exemption this certificate supported. Keep it while you wait for a new certificate, or remove it so tax is charged again.
certificates.decision.unknownExemption: We can't tell which exemption this certificate supports. Change the buyer's tax settings in Shopify if needed.
certificates.manage.heading: Certificate for {name}
certificates.reject.heading: Reject the certificate for {name}?
certificates.reject.body: The certificate is marked Rejected. The buyer isn't emailed; use Request new certificate to ask for another one.
certificates.expiry.heading: Expiry date for {name}
certificates.expiry.label: Expiry date
certificates.expiry.help: Renewal reminders restart from the new date. Leave empty if the certificate doesn't expire.
certificates.remove.heading: Remove the tax exemption for {name}?
certificates.remove.body: {exemption} will be removed from every company location of {name} in Shopify. Their next orders will be charged tax until you add it back.
certificates.error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
certificates.error.plan: Certificates are available on the Starter plan.
certificates.error.not_found: This certificate no longer exists. Refresh the page.
certificates.error.no_recipient: We couldn't find an email address for this buyer, or emails of this type are turned off.
certificates.error.no_buyer: This certificate isn't linked to a buyer yet.
certificates.error.unknown_exemption: We can't tell which exemption this certificate supports.
certificates.error.still_covered: Another valid certificate still covers this exemption, so it was kept.
certificates.error.shopify_error: Shopify didn't accept the change. Nothing was removed. Try again later.
certificates.error.unknown_intent: Something went wrong. Please try again.
certificates.error.file: We couldn't open this file. Please try again.
